SECRET
SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
S.I. Special Branch, Station, 2
REPORT
Date February 18, 1937.
（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE File No. REGISTRY No S I. D. 2299）
Subject Karl Albert Hans ZEIDLER, former leader of German Communist Party in
Dortmund, Prussia - movements in China.
Made by J.S. Pitts. Forwarded by J Boyne D.S.I.

reliable information has been received to the effect
that a German communist named Karl Albert Hans ZEIDLER ar-
rived in Shanghai during 1936 from Paris and later made his
way to the interior where he is now employed in a Chinese
engineering concern.
As a result of enquiries made it has been ascertained
that Zeidler was formerly leader of the German Communist
Party in Dortmund, Westphalia, Prussia and only relinquished
his post when Hitler came into power and purged Germany of
all reactionary elements. Zeidler then fled to France
where he remained until the latter part of 1935.
Zeidler arrived in Shanghai from Marseilles with his
wife Selma ZEIDLER (nee HAAS) on January 16, 1936 on board
the Messageries Maritimes s.s. "Marechal Joffre" and for
some time in the first half of 1936 was residing at No. 153C
Route des Soeurs.
An engineer by profession, Zeidler endeavoured to
secure employment with Messrs. Carlowitz soon after his arrival
here, but as he was unknown locally and could produce no sat-
isfactory references of service in Germany, his efforts
were in vain. Later, however, - in June or July, 1936 -
he was successful in making contact with a Mr. K.C. HU, the
managing director of the West China Development Corporation,
403 Shanghai Bank Building, 40 Ningpo Road. Through the
medium of Mr. Hu, Zeidler obtained a post as an engineer
on a year's contract with the Corporation's head office in
Chungking. Zeidler, accompanied by his wife, proceeded to
Chungking to take up his new duties during **〔此处转录不清〕** is still in

日期：1937年2月18日。
（印：上海公共租界工部局警务处 档案号 登记号 S.I.D. 2299）
事由：卡尔·阿尔伯特·汉斯·蔡德勒（Karl Albert Hans ZEIDLER），前普鲁士多特蒙德德国共产党领导人——在华活动情况。
制作人：J.S. 皮茨（J.S. Pitts）。转呈人：J. 博伊恩（J Boyne），副督察长。

已收到可靠情报，称一名名为卡尔·阿尔伯特·汉斯·蔡德勒的德国共产党员于1936年间从巴黎抵达上海，随后前往内地，目前受雇于一家中国工程公司。

经查询查明，蔡德勒曾任普鲁士威斯特法伦省多特蒙德地区德国共产党领导人，仅在希特勒掌权并清洗德国所有反动分子时才放弃其职位。随后蔡德勒逃往法国，并在那里停留至1935年下半年。

1936年1月16日，蔡德勒与其妻子塞尔玛·蔡德勒（Selma ZEIDLER，娘家姓哈斯 HAAS）乘坐法国邮船公司（Messageries Maritimes）的“马雷夏尔·约夫雷”号（s.s. "Marechal Joffre"）轮船从马赛抵达上海，在1936年上半年的一段时间内，居住在姐妹路（Route des Soeurs）153C号。

蔡德勒是一名职业工程师，抵达此处后不久曾试图在礼和洋行（Messrs. Carlowitz）谋职，但由于他在本地无人知晓，且无法提供令人满意的在德国服务的推荐信，其努力均告失败。然而后来，即在1936年6月或7月，他成功与华西开发公司（West China Development Corporation）总经理胡开诚（K.C. HU，音译）先生取得联系，该公司位于宁波路40号上海银行大楼403室。通过胡先生的中介，蔡德勒获得了一份与该总公司驻重庆办事处签订的为期一年的工程师合同。蔡德勒在其妻陪同下前往重庆就任新职，时间为**〔此处转录不清〕**，目前仍在

    Prior to leaving Shanghai for the interior and after
securing the position, Zeidler visited the local German Con-
sulate-General and stated that he and his wife had no German
passports and requested that they be issued with new documents
in order to permit them to travel freely in China and else-
where.    Questioned as to how they had entered China with-
out proper documents by the German consular representative,
the individuals in question were able to give an explanation
sufficiently plausible to induce the Consulate-General to
issue new passports without its suspicion being aroused as
to the identities of the applicants.    On July 15, 1936
Zeidler was issued with German Passport No. 253/36 and his
wife with Passport No. 254/36 by the local German Consulate-
General.    Both documents are valid for a period of one year
and were issued with the proviso that the recipients obtain
details of their previous German passports from the German
Foreign Office in Berlin and forward such particulars for
purposes of recording and information to the local authorities.
Up to the present, however, neither of the Zeidlers have
approached the local authorities to declare the required
details.

    在离开上海前往内地并获得该职位之前，蔡德勒曾拜访当地德国总领事馆，声称他和他的妻子没有德国护照，并请求签发新证件，以便允许他们在中国及其他地方自由旅行。当德国领事代表询问他们如何在没有适当证件的情况下进入中国时，相关人员给出了足以让总领事馆信服的解释，从而在未引起对申请人身份怀疑的情况下签发了新护照。1936年7月15日，当地德国总领事馆向蔡德勒签发了第253/36号德国护照，向其妻子签发了第254/36号护照。两份文件的有效期均为一年，签发时附有条件，即持证人需从柏林德国外交部获取其先前德国护照的详细信息，并将此类详情 forwarded 给当地当局以作记录和信息备案。然而截至目前，蔡德尔夫妇均未向当地当局申报所需详情。

    据查，蔡德勒在上海停留期间未进行任何具有政治性质的接触，但为进一步涵盖此点，正在进行进一步调查。由于目前尚不清楚他是否正在为中国共产党或第三国际工作，为避免

principles overboard. In this connection it must be mentioned
that quite a number of refugees from Germany, who left their
home country on account of their difference in political con-
victions, have now dropped these convictions and are earning
honest livelihoods in China.
It now transpires that Zeidler and his wife travelled to
Shanghai on a Nansen Passport - No. 6360, Series O. 1156, issued
on November 20, 1935 by the Ministry of Foreign Affairs in
Brussels, Belgium. This type of document is only issued
to political refugees and persons of no nationality.
Neither Zeidler nor his wife are Jews.
Zeidler was born at Regensberg, Bavaria on January 8,
1895 and his description is as follows:-
Age 42, Build; medium.
Eyes; blue Hair; fair.
Face; oval.
Mrs. Zeidler was born at Dortmund, Prussia on June 15,
1894 and is described as follows:-
Age; 42. Build; medium.
Eyes; Blue. Hair; auburn.
Face; oval.

使蔡德勒感到尴尬——他可能现在已经抛弃了其所有政治原则——故未向华西开发公司总经理胡先生索取信息。在此必须提及，相当数量的来自德国的难民，因政治信念不同而离开祖国，如今已放弃这些信念，在中国过着诚实的生活。

现查明，蔡德尔夫妇是持南森护照（Nansen Passport）——编号6360，O系列1156号——前往上海的，该护照由比利时布鲁塞尔外交部于1935年11月20日签发。此类文件仅签发给政治难民和无国籍人士。
蔡德勒及其妻子均非犹太人。

蔡德勒于1895年1月8日出生于巴伐利亚雷根斯贝格（Regensberg），其体貌特征如下：
年龄42岁，体型中等。
眼睛蓝色；头发浅色。
脸型椭圆。

蔡德勒夫人于1894年6月15日出生于普鲁士多特蒙德，其体貌特征如下：
年龄42岁。体型中等。
眼睛蓝色。头发赤褐色。
脸型椭圆。

随函附上蔡德勒先生和蔡德勒夫人的照片。
